items.title: Three signals that make the standing interval unsafe
items.situation: Scheduling maintenance on an asset with rising load.
items.content: Rising trend across consecutive readings, a reading more than a few days old, and the season starting. Any one is ignorable; together they mean the margin is smaller than the schedule implies.
items.why_it_matters: It is the judgment that keeps a calendar rule from sending an asset into peak demand unserviced.

items.title: Check neighbouring headroom before escalating
items.situation: A window cannot be taken without moving load.
items.content: Confirm the neighbouring feeder has genuine headroom, not nominal headroom, before raising an escalation.
items.why_it_matters: An escalation raised on nominal figures loses credibility.
